 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_key public.business_api_keys%rowtype;
declare v_month_count bigint;
declare v_minute_count bigint;
begin
  select * into v_key from public.business_api_keys where id = p_api_key_id and status = 'active';
  if v_key.id is null then return false; end if;

  select coalesce(sum(units),0) into v_month_count from public.api_usage_events
  where api_key_id = p_api_key_id and created_at >= date_trunc('month', now());
  if v_month_count >= v_key.monthly_quota then return false; end if;

  select coalesce(sum(units),0) into v_minute_count from public.api_usage_events
  where api_key_id = p_api_key_id and created_at >= now() - interval '1 minute';
  if v_minute_count >= v_key.rate_limit_per_minute then return false; end if;

  insert into public.api_usage_events(api_key_id, organization_id, request_kind, units)
  values (v_key.id, v_key.organization_id, 'request', 1);
  return true;
end;
$function$

provider.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
  )::text
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_org_role(target_org uuid, allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(public.org_role(target_org) = any(allowed_roles), false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_org_member(target_org uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.organization_members m
    where m.organization_id = target_org and m.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.org_role(target_org uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select m.role from public.organization_members m
  where m.organization_id = target_org and m.user_id = auth.uid()
  limit 1;
$function$
